0022600015.text: The Hornets (3-1, first in the Southeast, third in the East, on a two-game winning streak) visit the Wizards (2-2, ninth in the East, third in the Southeast and one game back) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Charlotte is without Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Tre Johnson and Tristan Vukcevic. The Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 110-103 win in Charlotte on October 26, and they won the 2025-26 series 4-0.
